title: Radiant Nuclear intro statements
description: A cream section of four short, bold statements stacked top-left, with a very wide picture cropped along the section's bottom edge. As the section scrolls in, the statements change colour word by word from teal to charcoal in reading order, and the picture rises 384px into place from below.
notes: a statement may hold "\n" for a deliberate line break
the picture is wider than the window and cropped by the section (988x480 on phones)
pure CSS scroll-driven; without scroll timelines or with reduced motion the text is charcoal and the picture sits in place
